006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.model.IModelInstanceAbsolute;
009import dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint.impl.DefaultCardinalityConstraint;
010import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
012import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
013
014/**
015 * Represents a rule requiring a Metaschema assembly data instance to have
016 * elements with a minimum and/or maximum occurrence.
017 */
018public interface ICardinalityConstraint extends IConfigurableMessageConstraint {
019  @Override
020  default Type getType() {
021    return Type.CARDINALITY;
022  }
023
024  /**
025   * Retrieve the required minimum occurrence of the target instance. If
026   * specified, this value must be less than or equal to the value of
027   * {@link IModelInstanceAbsolute#getMaxOccurs()} and greater than
028   * {@link IModelInstanceAbsolute#getMinOccurs()}.
029   *
030   * @return a non-negative integer or {@code null} if not defined
031   */
032  @Nullable
033  Integer getMinOccurs();
034
035  /**
036   * Retrieve the required maximum occurrence of the target instance. If
037   * specified, this value must be less than the value of
038   * {@link IModelInstanceAbsolute#getMaxOccurs()} and greater than or equal to
039   * {@link IModelInstanceAbsolute#getMinOccurs()}.
040   *
041   * @return a non-negative integer or {@code null} if not defined
042   */
043  @Nullable
044  Integer getMaxOccurs();
045
046  @Override
047  default <T, R> R accept(IConstraintVisitor<T, R> visitor, T state) {
048    return visitor.visitCardinalityConstraint(this, state);
049  }
050
051  /**
052   * Create a new constraint builder.
053   *
054   * @return the builder
055   */
056  @NonNull
057  static Builder builder() {
058    return new Builder();
059  }
060
061  /**
062   * Provides a builder pattern for constructing a new
063   * {@link ICardinalityConstraint}.
064   */
065  final class Builder
066      extends AbstractConfigurableMessageConstraintBuilder<Builder, ICardinalityConstraint> {
067    private Integer minOccurs;
068    private Integer maxOccurs;
069
070    private Builder() {
071      // disable construction
072    }
073
074    /**
075     * Use the provided minimum occurrence to validate associated targets.
076     *
077     * @param value
078     *          the expected occurrence
079     * @return this builder
080     */
081    public Builder minOccurs(int value) {
082      this.minOccurs = value;
083      return this;
084    }
085
086    /**
087     * Use the provided maximum occurrence to validate associated targets.
088     *
089     * @param value
090     *          the expected occurrence
091     * @return this builder
092     */
093    public Builder maxOccurs(int value) {
094      this.maxOccurs = value;
095      return this;
096    }
097
098    @Override
099    protected Builder getThis() {
100      return this;
101    }
102
103    @Override
104    protected void validate() {
105      super.validate();
106
107      if (getMinOccurs() == null && getMaxOccurs() == null) {
108        throw new ConstraintInitializationException("At least one of minOccurs or maxOccurs must be provided.");
109      }
110    }
111
112    private Integer getMinOccurs() {
113      return minOccurs;
114    }
115
116    private Integer getMaxOccurs() {
117      return maxOccurs;
118    }
119
120    @Override
121    protected ICardinalityConstraint newInstance() {
122      return new DefaultCardinalityConstraint(
123          getId(),
124          getFormalName(),
125          getDescription(),
126          ObjectUtils.notNull(getSource()),
127          getLevel(),
128          getTarget(),
129          getProperties(),
130          getMinOccurs(),
131          getMaxOccurs(),
132          getMessage(),
133          getRemarks());
134    }
135  }
136}
